shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on September 27 that Iran will not make concessions to the United States on its stated conditions, and that any opening of the Strait of Hormuz depends on whether Iran's conditions are met.

title: Iran's Foreign Minister Says Strait of Hormuz Opening Depends on Tehran's Conditions
